description: Get the raw current extract (odpis aktualny) of an entity from KRS as JSON – all register sections as they stand today (tens of thousands of characters for a large company; prefer Check_KRS_Status for a compact answer). Entities struck off the register have no current extract. The register (P/S) is optional – both are checked when omitted.

rejestr.description: Rejestr: P – przedsiębiorców, S – stowarzyszeń. Pomiń, aby sprawdzić oba rejestry.
